The published response is the actual handler DTO, so known session, die,
pending, session-mode, bandwidth, rollable, recovery, read, snooze, skip and
timezone fields stay in the live contract. Stored tag records, recovery
nodes and mode-guidance JSON remain explicitly extensible.

AnalyticsMetricsResponse.description: Reading metrics and analytics for the authenticated user.

BootstrapActiveThread.description: Currently pending thread shown by the Roll surface.

tags.description: Stored tag records; unknown stored columns are preserved via flatten.

BootstrapBandwidth.description: Compact bandwidth block retained for existing Roll consumers.

BootstrapIdentitySummary.description: Mapping state for a rollable candidate.

BootstrapIssueSummary.description: Candidate issue identity displayed on a Roll face.

BootstrapLastRead.description: Most recent rated issue for the active session.

BootstrapReaderStats.description: Reader statistics for one rollable face or canonical series run.

BootstrapResponseV2.description:
Full live `GET /api/v2/roll/bootstrap` payload.

This is the actual handler response type, so the generated contract and the
runtime share one authority. It is retained only until the bootstrap
retirement work removes the route; it is not a new feature surface.

BootstrapRollRecovery.description:
Bounded recovery diagnostic shown when the pending issue is blocked.

The stable envelope is typed; each nested blocker/chain/diagnostic entry is
the existing bounded JSON node shape and remains extensible so no current
recovery detail is dropped from the live contract.

BootstrapRoute.description: One Roll route label attached to a rollable face.

BootstrapSessionMode.description: Legacy session-mode bridge retained on the live bootstrap contract.

session_mode_correction_guidance.description: Extension boundary: stored guidance JSON is passed through verbatim.

BootstrapTag.description:
One tag visible to the reader on a Roll thread row.

The stable stored tag columns are typed; `extra` preserves any additional
stored columns so future tag metadata is never silently dropped.

BootstrapThreadSummary.description: Owner-scoped thread summary shown by Roll snooze/skip chips and rollable rows.

ComicPileMatch.description: Owner-scoped local representations of a related ComicVine issue.

ComicVineMappingHealth.description: Compact confirmed ComicVine mapping health for one queue row.

Creator.description: An issue's credited creator with stable provider identity and merged roles.

CsrfResponse.description: Response body carrying a double-submit CSRF token.

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Request body for an enumeration-safe password-recovery email.

InitializeSessionRequest.description:
Temporary explicit write boundary for legacy reading-session consumers.
GET /api/v2/roll/bootstrap never creates or mutates a session.

comicvine_issue_id.description: Confirmed provider issue identifier, never a provisional candidate.

cover_image_url.description: Exact provider-supplied CDN URL. Null when unmapped; never image bytes.

has_confirmed_identity.description: Whether a confirmed ComicVine issue mapping exists.

issue_number.description: Exact issue number within the run.

issue_ids.description: Visible issue identifiers requested for one bounded batch.

items.description: Owned cards in first-request order; foreign or missing IDs are omitted.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated retry key. Same key/payload replays the same receipt.

rating.description: Effective issue rating in 0.5-point steps. Omit to keep the stored rating.

source.description:
Source of the issue action. Omitted or "direct" is a manual read from a
Thread row: it never steps the die and never repositions the queue.
"roll_offer" is a Roll completion: it applies the Roll rating semantics
(die stepping, queue placement, and a link back to the originating offer
event) in the same transaction as the read.

status.description: Explicit new status. Omit to leave read state unchanged.

die_after.description: Die after this rating, when source is "roll_offer". Null for "direct" source.

LoginRequest.description:
Request body for username/password login.

Login deliberately does not impose the registration minimum length: accounts
created before the current policy must still be able to sign in. An empty
password is rejected by bcrypt verification with the same non-enumerating
401 as any other incorrect credential, matching Python.

PasswordResetResponse.description: Safe acknowledgement returned whether or not an account exists.

PoolReason.description:
Why the Roll pool has no in-play faces.

Derived from the already-loaded Option E inputs and the eligible frontier
set. This is a single reason, never a list or a whole-library report, and it
adds no database work: it exists so a genuinely non-empty library does not
render the false "reading queue is empty" state (#4441).

QueueEntryPatch.description: Resource patch for one queue entry.

position.description: Target reader-visible ordinal. Ranks beyond the end place the entry last.

QueueEntryResponse.description: Queue entry resource returned by GET and PATCH.

ordering_version.description:
Content revision of the reader's current queue order.

Derived from the durable ordering state on every read, so it changes
whenever any writer changes the order and stays equal while the order is
unchanged. It is a change-detection token, not a persisted per-entry
counter and not the #3227 sparse order key.

thread_id.description: Canonical queue-entry identity: the owned Thread id.

idempotency_key.description: Client retry key. Replaying a committed key returns the same revision.

replayed.description: True when an identical `idempotency_key` was already committed.

shuffled.description: Number of entries whose position this revision wrote.

QueueSeriesMetadata.description: Confirmed provider series metadata for one queue row.

ReadingSessionCreatedResponse.description: Result of the explicit v2 reading-session initialization write.

RecentSession.description: Summary of one recent reading session.

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Optional request body for token refresh; the refresh cookie is also accepted.

RelatedIssue.description: Related issue derived from a confirmed explicit story-arc relationship.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Request body for completing a password reset with a single-use token.

RollDieStateResponse.description: The reader's current logical die and the approved ladder.

default_die.description: The die an explicit reset returns to.

ladder.description: The approved dice ladder, smallest to largest.

oneOf.description: The most recent recorded roll, when the reader has rolled.

RollEligibleIssueIdsResponse.description: The ordered eligible issue identifiers for the current die.

die.description: The logical die that bounded the list.

issue_ids.description: The eligible issue identifiers, in queue order.

thread_ids.description: The owning thread identifiers, parallel to `issue_ids`.

RollLastRoll.description: The most recent Roll recorded for this reader.

die.description: The die that produced the roll.

idempotency_key.description: Stable client key; retries return the original offer without re-rolling.

snoozed_thread_ids.description: Threads this browser has temporarily snoozed (cookie authority only).

timezone.description: Browser timezone used only by the retained session bridge.

snoozed_thread_id.description: Thread snoozed by this request so the browser can extend its cookie.

StoryArc.description: A provider story arc with bounded related issues and a correct total.

ThreadTag.description: One tag visible to the reader.

TokenResponse.description: Response body for token endpoints, matching the Python wire contract.

TopRatedThread.description: Summary of one highly rated thread.

UserResponse.description: Response body for the current-user endpoint.
